description: Self-doc slices lack an automated AST-normalised behaviour-preservation check proving that stripping docstrings and comments did not alter Python runtime syntax trees.
goal: Add a fast AST-normalisation script scripts/check_self_doc_behavior.py (with pure importable helpers and a CLI entry point checking a git diff revision range) that strips only leading module/class/function docstring expressions (substituting pass when a body would otherwise become empty) and comments, compares ast.dump(tree, include_attributes=False) before vs after for every modified Python file, and fails if any non-docstring/non-comment AST node changed. Add a new pull_request workflow .github/workflows/test-self-doc-behavior.yml (using block-form 'on:\n  pull_request:' triggers and Prettier-compliant YAML formatting) that runs this check on PRs labelled or titled as self-doc changes or whose diff touches only comments/docstrings/self-doc tests, and register test-self-doc-behavior.yml in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_ci_bookkeeping_wiring.py (UNGATED/WIRING). Do not edit existing workflows or README files. Add unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_check_self_doc_behavior.py proving real docstring/comment removals pass (including empty body pass substitution) while a sneaked code change fails and trigger detection covers label, title, and diff-only cases. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Adding an AST-normalised equivalence check in CI proves comment/docstring cleanup preserves behaviour without needing per-slice test file copies.
acceptance_criteria: An AST-normalised before/after check in scripts/check_self_doc_behavior.py proves a self-doc change is behaviour-preserving: the AST of each changed module, with docstrings and comments stripped, is identical before and after.

That check runs in CI (.github/workflows/test-self-doc-behavior.yml, registered in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_ci_bookkeeping_wiring.py with block-form pull_request trigger and Prettier-valid YAML) for PRs labelled or titled as self-doc changes, or for any PR whose diff only removes docstrings or comments.

Tests for the check in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_check_self_doc_behavior.py: a real removal of docstrings and comments passes; a sneaked code change fails; passes uv run pytest and uv run task lint with no reduction in what the gate enforces.
